name: threatdown-mcp
description: Every ThreatDown OneView API, plus fleet-wide stale-endpoint, health and seat reports across all your sites, and guarded isolate/scan/restore jobs.

threatdown_client_id.title: THREATDOWN_CLIENT_ID
threatdown_client_id.description: OAuth2 client id of the OneView API client (OneView > Integrate).

threatdown_client_secret.title: THREATDOWN_CLIENT_SECRET
threatdown_client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret paired with the client id; OneView shows it only once.

threatdown_oauth_scope.title: OAuth scopes to request
threatdown_oauth_scope.description: Space-separated OneView scopes the CLI requests when it mints a token. Leave blank for the default `execute read write`; set `read` for a reporting-only setup. The respond commands need `execute`.

threatdown_base_url.title: OneView API base URL
threatdown_base_url.description: Overrides the OneView API base URL. Leave blank for the default https://api.threatdown.com/oneview.

threatdown_token_url.title: OAuth token URL
threatdown_token_url.description: Overrides the OAuth2 token endpoint. Leave blank for the default https://api.threatdown.com/oneview/oauth2/token.

threatdown_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
threatdown_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on OneView requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

threatdown_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP server
threatdown_mcp_read_only.description: Set to exactly 1 to drop the MCP server's write tools (including the respond job verbs) and refuse every non-GET call, and endpoints diag-log, through threatdown_execute. Leave blank for the full tool set.

threatdown_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
threatdown_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Not enforced by this connector: ThreatDown has no tenant-gated client profiles, so a value here does not limit which customer sites a call can reach. Leave blank. To limit what an agent can do, give it a read-only OAuth client.
